name: MailerLite
description: MailerLite is an email marketing platform for subscribers, groups, segments, campaigns, automations, forms, landing pages, and ecommerce messaging. Organizations use it to grow audiences and operate email marketing programs.
agentUseSummary: Connect one MailerLite account with an encrypted customer-generated API token owned by a dedicated least-privilege user. Relay exposes only one selected subscriber's ID and timestamps plus bounded metadata for one selected campaign, pins the 2026-07-17 API version, and blocks subscriber identity, engagement, other resources, sending, automation, exports, and mutations.

credentialRequirements.name: MAILERLITE_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: MailerLite API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: A customer-generated token from a dedicated least-privilege MailerLite user; Relay encrypts it and sends it only to connect.mailerlite.com.

credentialRequirements.name: MAILERLITE_SUBSCRIBER_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected numeric subscriber ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The numeric subscriber ID whose ID and timestamps Relay may read; email selectors are rejected.

credentialRequirements.name: MAILERLITE_CAMPAIGN_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected campaign ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The one campaign whose bounded summary Relay may read.

capabilities.label: Read selected subscriber summary
capabilities.description: Read only the ID and timestamps for one selected subscriber without identity, contact, consent, status, engagement, IP, group, or custom fields.

capabilities.label: Read selected campaign summary
capabilities.description: Read bounded organizational metadata for one selected campaign.

allowed.label: Read selected subscriber summary
allowed.description: Read the selected subscriber's ID and timestamps while discarding all personal, preference, and engagement fields.

allowed.label: Read selected campaign summary
allowed.description: Read the selected campaign's ID, name, type, status, and timestamps while discarding content, sender, recipients, filters, settings, reports, and related resources.

blocked.label: Expose private marketing data
blocked.description: Subscriber identity, contact, consent, status, engagement, IP, group, and custom fields plus campaign recipients, content, sender, filters, settings, reports, and raw responses are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate MailerLite state
blocked.description: Subscriber changes, imports, groups, segments, campaigns, sends, automations, forms, webhooks, ecommerce data, and every other mutation are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad MailerLite access
blocked.description: Other subscribers, campaigns, groups, segments, fields, automations, forms, lists, searches, pages, activities, arbitrary paths, redirects, downloads, and exports are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read Only
approvalProfiles.description: Read one selected subscriber and campaign through an encrypted customer token; private data, broader access, and mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway stores the encrypted customer token server-side and mounts exactly two version-pinned projected reads.
Railway stores the encrypted customer token server-side and mounts exactly two version-pinned projected reads.

providerSetup.blocker: A new MailerLite account, dedicated least-privilege user, customer-generated API token, numeric staging subscriber ID, and campaign ID are required. No authorized account or credentials are available in this worker lane.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized MailerLite administrator must create a dedicated staging user with only the minimum account permissions for the two reads, generate and immediately capture its API token in the provider-console lane, connect the numeric subscriber and campaign IDs, then validate both redacted reads, email-selector denial, version pinning, insufficient-permission and rate errors, token replacement, user-removal revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in Fairfax.

evidence.supports: MailerLite documents the connect.mailerlite.com/api origin, customer-generated bearer API tokens, user-bound token lifecycle, immediate one-time secret capture, date-based X-Version pinning, 120 requests per minute, and standard error codes.

MailerLite documents selected subscriber reads by numeric ID or email and the sensitive identity, preference, engagement, group, IP, and custom fields excluded by Relay; Relay accepts numeric IDs only.
MailerLite documents selected campaign reads and the campaign metadata used for Relay's bounded projection, plus the content, sender, targeting, report, and recipient data Relay excludes.
